subject: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list & PO path for VentureLink
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@venturelink.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@venturelink.io
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started - procurement items we need

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. Procurement asked me to follow up with the security and contracting artifacts we need to complete our vendor intake. At minimum they requested:
- DPA (latest executed version)
- SOC 2 report (Type II) or a link to the hosted report
- Current subprocessor roster
- Quote and PO instructions (who issues PO, billing address, contact)

Can you send those over or point me to where VentureLink’s procurement team can download signed artifacts? We are on a tight timeline for our pilot, aiming to have billing set up by Aug 10.

Appreciate it —
Samir

Head of Integrations, VentureLink
samir.patel@venturelink.io
+1 415-555-0142

Samir — thanks for the clear list. I’m looping in Laura (Contracts) and Ben (Security & Privacy) to share the artifacts and confirm PO flow. Quick notes:
- We have a standard DPA (attached). If you need edits, Laura can handle redlines.
- SOC 2 Type II is hosted behind a secured link; Ben will share access instructions.
- Subprocessor roster is attached as a CSV; we keep it updated monthly.
- PO instructions below. If you prefer we can accept vendor portal invoices as well.

PO / billing details (summary):
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.com
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwood.com (please include Deal ID DL-8791 on invoice)
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, 2200 Redwood Ave, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Standard net terms: Net 30 (can discuss NET 45 with procurement)

I’ll send the attachments and links in a follow-up from Ben/Laura.

—Karthik

Hi Samir / Karthik,

Sharing the items VentureLink requested:

1) DPA (attached): Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf — this is our current standard. If your legal team needs a few small contract redlines (data deletion window, subprocessors clause), flag them and Laura will coordinate.

2) SOC 2 Type II: we host the report and access is granted via a short-lived link. For VentureLink I generated a reviewer link — expires in 7 days: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.html

3) Subprocessors: attached CSV Subprocessors_List_20260801.csv — includes vendor, purpose, data processed, and location.

4) Evidence & attestation: If procurement needs specific control evidence (policy docs, encryption attestations), let me know which controls and I’ll provide the artifacts or a summary.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: Subprocessors_List_20260801.csv (CSV)]

If anything else is required for compliance sign-off, reply and we’ll prioritize it.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Security & Privacy Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@venturelink.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting started - procurement items we need

Samir — thanks. If VentureLink is ready to proceed, next steps for contracting and PO issuance:

1) Review DPA and SOC 2 link. If you have redlines to the DPA, please send a marked PDF or DocuSign redline request.
2) Signatures: We can e-sign via DocuSign (preferred) or exchange signed PDFs. DocuSign envelope prepared here: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef123456
3) PO details: once DPA executed we can issue a PO for the pilot. Please confirm:
   - Entity name to appear on PO (legal name)
   - Billing contact email for invoice dispatch
   - Preferred payment terms (Net 30 default)
4) If procurement needs a vendor setup packet (W9, company registration), attach the vendor packet in reply and I’ll route to accounting.

I can accept DPA redlines and coordinate with Legal; if there are few edits we often resolve within 48 hours. Let me know the legal point of contact.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@venturelink.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting started - procurement items we need

Thanks — that helps. Quick status update from our side:
- Legal reviewed the DPA and requested two small edits (data retention window to 90 days; clarification on subprocessor notice cadence). I’ve attached a redline PDF to this message.
- Procurement confirmed the legal entity: VentureLink, Inc. — send PO to billing@venturelink.io and reference DL-8791.
- We’ll use DocuSign for signatures; I’ve opened the envelope on our side and can sign once you share it.

I attached the redlined DPA and our vendor setup packet (W-9 + company registration). Please review and advise on timing — pilot billing target still Aug 10 if possible.

Samir
